summary.text: Jonathan King is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 19, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign website describes him as a Rochester resident with a 15-year career in IT and cybersecurity.

paragraphs.text: On his campaign website, King says he took a job as a dispatcher at 18, built a 15-year career in IT and cybersecurity, earned a master's degree and is raising his family in Rochester.
The site identifies his district as Strafford District 19, covering Rochester Wards 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6.
King's website says he is running on lowering costs, strengthening communities and government accountability.
Issue headings on the site include stopping wasteful spending, keeping public money in public schools, capping assessment increases to protect fixed incomes, and cannabis reform.
